points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake source is substantial and the terminal response claims a build, but no independent evaluator build was performed and the delivered immutable commit has no build artifact.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp implements solve --case/--output/--restart/--report-level and argparse error handling.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate C++ modules cover case parsing, CGNS, geometry, partitioning, halo, reconstruction, flux, output, and solver logic.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal wrapper/external-executable evidence was found. Trust policy prohibits external-copy investigation.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: JSON case reader and generic case paths are present; no two-mesh-only branch was established.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp calls METIS_PartGraphKway and halo.cpp implements neighbor MPI_Isend/Irecv; no delivered rank-consistency demonstration.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Six readable NACA outputs are marked failed, laminar histories become non-finite, and both cylinder final packages are absent.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No passing final validator/test evidence: the official validator aborts on the first canonical package's failed metadata.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: The immutable source tree is reasonably modular and has no committed build/result/session bulk artifacts.

disqualification_flags.evidence: See the explicit trigger-7 finding in the top-level disqualification assessment.
